title: The Apothecary Diaries
author: Shénbǐ (unofficial fan pack)
description: Herbs, poisons and palace life, themed on The Apothecary Diaries (药屋少女的呢喃): 20 words (a medicine chest, silver needles, a hairpin…, plus 猫猫 Maomao and 壬氏 Jinshi), a short story of our own about a poisoned cat, and 15 sentences to read.

words.hint: 艹 (plants) on top: old medicine was made from plants.
草 grass + 药 medicine: plants that heal.
The part at the bottom, 毋, means 'don't!' Don't eat it.
药 medicine + 师 master (as in 老师 teacher).
箱 box has 竹 (bamboo) on top: boxes were woven from bamboo.
瓶 bottle has 瓦 (pottery) on the right.
钅 (metal) on the left of both. Silver was said to turn black near poison.
研 grind has 石 (stone) on the left; 钵 is a bowl.
发 hair + 簪 hairpin (竹 bamboo on top: the first ones were bamboo).
皇 is 白 above 王 (king): the shining king, the emperor.

words.en: the inner palace (where the emperor's consorts live)
words.hint: 后 behind + 宫 palace: the palace behind the court.
宫 palace + 女 woman.
Both characters have 宀, a roof: officials who lived inside the palace.
艹 (plants) on top: many herbs taste bitter.
禾 (grain) over 日 (sun): grain warm in the sun smells good.
好 is said hào here, 'to love' + 奇 strange: loving strange things.

words.en: to get sick; to be ill
words.hint: 病 illness has 疒, the 'sickbed' part.
Both have 必 (must) inside: a secret must be kept.

words.en: Maomao (the apothecary girl; her name means 'kitty')
words.hint: Her name is 猫 cat, twice.
壬 is a rare character; it looks like 王 (king) with a slanted top stroke.

books.title: 皇帝的猫
books.blurb: Someone has poisoned the emperor's cat. Maomao takes a look.

pages.en: Maomao is an apothecary. She is small, but very clever.
She has a medicine chest. In the medicine chest there are lots of herbs.
One day, the emperor's cat fell ill.
The palace maids were all scared: "What did the cat eat?"
Maomao took a look at the cat's food. She tested it with a silver needle.
tokens: to give it a try; to test

pages.en: The silver needle turned black! There is poison in the food.
Maomao said: "Don't be afraid. This herb is bitter, but once the cat drinks it, it will be fine."
The next day the cat was very happy and ran all around the garden.
Jinshi smiled: "Maomao, you really are a good apothecary!"
Maomao said: "I only like poisons and medicines."

sentences.en: Do you have a medicine chest?
The palace maid is Maomao's friend.
The emperor has two medicine bottles.
